_note: The fifteen modules a proposal is assembled from. Agreed with Paul 28 Aug 2026 after an audit of all eight built pages found the names had drifted. This file is the source of truth for both the template page at /for/template and for any agent picking modules. Pick by slug, never by number: the number is display order on the template and will change when a module is added.

_naming_changes.outbound-agent: Was called Outreach on most pages. Outreach is the exhibit inside it, not the product.
_naming_changes.search-agent: Replaces both the placeholder card cascade called Search and GEO Agent and the section title What AI assistants say about X. One product, the audit is its exhibit.
_naming_changes.ai-writer: Kept over Copywriter. Seven pages and Paul's own essay already say AI writer, so products.md is the file that changes.

_not_a_module: The sections in "furniture" below are on every page and nobody picks them, so they have no number. Anything reading a built page has to tell them from modules, and the template marks them on their own strip rather than leaving it to a convention written nowhere.

furniture.title: What this is
furniture.note: The only place the client's own situation appears. Everything below it is our work or a demonstration, and the section says so.

furniture.title: What we do
furniture.note: Paul's bio block. Lifted verbatim on every page. Never rewritten, never retyped.

furniture.title: What Run with Foxes does
furniture.note: The four things figure and Paul's paragraph. This is the full range, shown before the page narrows to the picked modules.

furniture.title: How it would work
furniture.note: Parent of four subs: how your team would use it, the first weeks, no Claude licence needed, what comes after.

furniture.title: What we'd recommend
furniture.note: Names which option Paul would take. Off the page entirely on the information-only shape.

furniture.title: The price
furniture.note: Three cards, or one, or absent. Every number is Paul's.

furniture.title: Case studies
furniture.note: Agreed name. Called The work on three older pages, Case studies on four. Same section.

furniture.title: Essays
furniture.note: Agreed name. Called Your library on five older pages, Essays on the two newest. Same section. Holds essays, the course and the book.

furniture.title: The next step
furniture.note: What happens next. On a priced page it follows the price; on an information-only page it is the close and there is no price above it.

shapes.name: Priced proposal
shapes.note: Recommendation, then three price cards with the third deliberately expensive so the middle reads as sensible. Featured goes on the middle card and nowhere else. Kite and Expleo.
shapes.variant: One card instead of three where only one thing is being bought. Ace Express.

shapes.name: Capabilities, no price
shapes.note: The modules, no recommendation and no price. Ends on the case studies and the reading list. Fidelity, Affirm, Return2Sender.

shapes.name: Information only
shapes.note: No price and no recommendation, and the close is a conversation rather than a decision. Great National, and the shape Paul wants for Imagine.

openings.name: Their own site rebuilt
openings.note: Full bleed above the masthead, a real page in an iframe rather than a screenshot, no caption. Boreman. Needs the rebuild built first, and it is a demonstration of what we can make rather than a criticism of what they have.

openings.name: Plain masthead
openings.note: The page opens on the title. Every page except Boreman.

modules.name: Rethinking the roles
modules.shows: The figure that opens the argument: the things that used to be whole roles become tasks inside someone's job.

modules.name: Redesigning workflows
modules.shows: One window, two worlds. A draggable line wipes between a marketing function as it runs today, handovers and all, and the same function with AI.

modules.name: Designing team AI adoption
modules.shows: 140 blocks of work changing across four quarters, animated, every stop clickable, with speed, cost and volume measured underneath. Rows are areas of work, never people.

modules.name: Training teams
modules.shows: The course's first module, the real page, scrolled top to bottom.

modules.name: Growth Agent
modules.shows: A pipeline board whose cards move stage to stage, the morning note typing itself out, and a campaign running through.

modules.name: Outbound Agent
modules.shows: An outreach inbox with real-looking threads and the replies they got. Every person and firm in it is invented and the page says so.
modules.requires: Threads written in the client's own world. Never a real contact of theirs.

modules.name: AI Writer
modules.shows: A finished email the writer produced. Hovering a dotted line shows which brand document that line came from.

modules.name: Brand Guardian
modules.shows: An x-ray slider over one of Sabre's real ads. Drag the line to see what the machine measures, with the numbers drawn on.
modules.requires: No check count in the copy. The gates that run depend on the asset type, so the exhibit reports what actually ran.

modules.name: Creative Director
modules.shows: Real Sabre work. Their agency's live ad beside our machine's rebuild, the photograph turned to video, and the range of stills.

modules.name: Advertising Agent
modules.shows: One approved master ad spawns the whole size set on screen. Real files from our own dayone campaign.

modules.name: Brief Coach
modules.shows: The coach pressure-tests a launch brief. One click plays the whole session.
modules.requires: A team with a brief and an approval chain. Pointless for a company of five.

modules.name: Ghostwriter
modules.shows: A card with four formats falling out of it: long piece, posts, chart, newsletter.

modules.name: Lifecycle Agent
modules.shows: A card with four moments falling out of it: onboard, nudge, win back, grow.
modules.requires: A real list to send to. Pointless where the client's list is info@ addresses.

modules.name: Search Agent
modules.shows: A measured sample of what AI assistants say about the client's brand today, run for them before the page is built.
modules.requires: The audit has to be run first by the search desk. Never offer this module before it exists for that client.

modules.name: Website Agent
modules.shows: The client's own site rebuilt, live in the page, full bleed above the masthead before any Run with Foxes words appear.
modules.requires: The rebuild has to be built first. It is a demonstration of what we can make and never a criticism of the site they have.

modules.name: Reporting Suite
modules.shows: One window carrying the client's own funnel stages across the top, traffic through to closed won, with the channel panels underneath and a second agent that checks the first one's numbers against the sources before the report goes out.
modules.requires: The funnel stages have to be named the way the client names them, off the call, or it reads as a dashboard vendor's demo. Every figure inside the frame is invented and the exhibit says so on its face. Never put the client's real totals in the frame: illustrative numbers sitting beside real ones read as measured too, and then the page has claimed we looked at a funnel we have never seen. Their real numbers go in the prose around it.
